content:
liang: Heads-up: new int4 quant build (q4-alt) on staging shows a consistent BLEU drop on a small zh->ja testset. Preliminary delta -3.1. Looks tied to ZWNJ handling in tokenization/detok. Anyone seen this before?

yuko: can you paste a failing example?

liang: sure — here's one pair from the subset. base (fp16) translation is fine, q4-alt collapses a token boundary around a zero-width non-joiner.

liang: ```
SOURCE (zh): 我们在测试零宽不连接符\u200C的处理
FP16 tokenized: ["我","们","在","测试","零宽","\u200C","不","连接","符"]
Q4-ALT tokenized: ["我","们","在","测试","零宽不连接符"]
DETOK_FP16: 私たちはゼロ幅の非接続文字をテストします
DETOK_Q4: 私たちはゼロ幅非接続文字をテストします   # missing particle spacing -> alters translation output
```

sam: ugh. That looks like the runtime preproc merged the ZWNJ into neighboring token. Could also be normalization (NFC vs NFKC) or a regex that trims invisible chars. Was this run against the same SentencePiece vocabulary?

liang: yes same vocab. We traced to commit deploy-runtime@3f2a9a that flipped `strip_invisible_chars=True` in the fast preprocessor to save ~0.5ms/request. It strips control/invisible chars and wasn't whitelisting U+200C/U+200D.

anya: is this happening during eval dataset preprocessing or only in serving runtime?

liang: serving runtime only — our eval harness runs both: one with `detok=runtime` and one with offline detok. The runtime path introduced the regression. Repro: 

liang: ```
# reproduce locally (staging image)
python eval/run_translation.py \
  --model q4-alt \
  --src zh --tgt ja \
  --input examples/zwnj_cases.txt \
  --detok runtime \
  --limit 50
```

matt: quick mitigation: revert the strip flag and add a whitelist to preserve ZWNJ (U+200C) and ZWJ (U+200D). Also add unit tests with mixed-width CJK + ZWNJ cases.

yuko: :thumbsup: I'll open a PR to revert + add tests. Will include cases for ZWNJ, ZWJ, soft-hyphen, and zero-width joiners used in Arabic/Indic pipelines.

eval-bot: eval-job completed: job_id=ej-9182, BLEU_q4-alt=21.7, BLEU_fp16=24.8, delta=-3.1. Full logs: https://internal-ci/redwood/evals/ej-9182

liang: assigning: @yuko to revert and add tests; @sam to validate tokenizer diffs across builds and ensure no vocabulary drift. After unit tests pass we'll canary the runtime change. Also filing a short customer-impact note — docs team flagged a couple of zh->ja pages as degraded.

sam: I will run a quick token-diff script across the first 10k eval sentences to see if this pattern appears elsewhere.

anya: please add a couple of targeted examples to the regression-suite so CI will catch it in future.

yuko: will do, pushing PR in ~45m. label: priority-high

liang: thanks everyone. small but visible regression — good catch by the subset run.

matt: sgtm. file a short incident in #incidents if customers affected.

liang: noted.
